item.title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
item.description: Saudi authorities say the latest attack on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, has killed 12 people and injured over 300. Their statement says the dead on Saturday included four Saudi citizens as well as two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese. It said some of those injured were in critical condition. The attack — the latest of several in the past week on King Khalid International Airport — is expected to increase Saudi pressure on allies including the United States to provide military support for the kingdom. Fuente: NPR - World.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: Nidal Hasan: críticas al Pentágono por decisión de transmitir su fusilamiento
item.description: El exmayor del Ejército Nidal Hasan, condenado a muerte por asesinar a 13 personas en un ataque en la base de Fort Hood, Texas, en 2009, será el primer militar ejecutado por un pelotón de fusilamiento desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial. El secretario de Defensa de Estados Unidos, Pete Hegseth, afirmó que la ejecución, prevista para el 3 de diciembre, será pública, y un funcionario del Pentágono confirmó que se transmitirá en directo. La decisión de Hegseth ya ha despertado críticas. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
